gloss: to wilt; to droop; to be dejected

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {萎|しお}れていませんでした

definitions.explanation: When plants or flowers lose their freshness and become limp, often due to lack of water.

definitions.gloss: to be dejected; to be dispirited
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, when a person loses energy or becomes depressed.

notes:
{萎|しお}れる is an intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧). There is no common transitive pair.

ASPECT (ている):
{萎|しお}れて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates an ongoing or resulting state of being wilted or dejected.

{萎|しお}れる VS ⟦{枯|か}れる→枯れる：04589_kareru⟧:
- {萎|しお}れる describes a temporary, often reversible state of drooping or wilting
- ⟦{枯|か}れる→枯れる：04589_kareru⟧ describes permanent death or drying up of plants
- A flower that {萎|しお}れる may recover with water, but one that ⟦{枯|か}れる→枯れる：04589_kareru⟧ is dead

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{萎|しお}れる - flowers wilt
- ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{萎|しお}れる - vegetables go limp
- ⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{萎|しお}れる - spirits droop

USAGE:
When used for people, {萎|しお}れる describes a deflated, dejected emotional state, similar to a wilting plant.
